pairs.why: The objects are nearly identical, but B's smooth lavender cloth fits the soft, low-texture finish of the real cards better than A's coarser white linen.
This is the same pair as q000 with the sides swapped: A's smooth lavender cloth reads closer to the real cards than B's more textured white linen.
The chest is the same in both, but B's smooth, warm sandy tiles match the real cards' clean, low-texture finish, while A's grey flagstones are gritty and over-textured.
This is q002 with the sides swapped: A's smooth sandy floor fits the real cards, while B's gritty grey stone floor is too texture-heavy.
A's warm cream feather and soft cast shadow sit in the warm light like the real cards, while B's stark white feather looks colder and more plastic.
This is q004 with the sides swapped: B's cream feather and grounding shadow match the warm, soft finish of the real cards better than A's bright white plastic-looking feather.
